expr: (let allSubseq (arr : List Char) := (arr.foldl fun acc x => acc ++ acc.map (fun sub => x :: sub)) [[]] |>.map List.reverse; let subseqA := allSubseq s1.toList; let subseqB := allSubseq s2.toList; let commonSubseq := subseqA.filter (fun l => subseqB.contains l); String.mk (commonSubseq.foldl (fun best l => if best.length < l.length then l else best) []))

lemmas.name: lcs_str_spec
lemmas.statement: ∀ (L : List (List Char)), [] ∈ L → L.contains (String.mk (L.foldl (fun best l => if best.length < l.length then l else best) [])).toList = true ∧ L.all (fun l => decide (l.length ≤ (String.mk (L.foldl (fun best l => if best.length < l.length then l else best) [])).length)) = true
lemmas.proof:
by intro L hn
  have hs := Refine.longest_spec L hn
  rw [Refine.string_toList_mk, Refine.string_length_mk]
  exact hs

lemmas.name: lcs_str_ok
lemmas.statement: ∀ (s1 s2 : String) (h : longestCommonSubsequence_precond s1 s2), longestCommonSubsequence_postcond s1 s2 (let allSubseq (arr : List Char) := (arr.foldl fun acc x => acc ++ acc.map (fun sub => x :: sub)) [[]] |>.map List.reverse; let subseqA := allSubseq s1.toList; let subseqB := allSubseq s2.toList; let commonSubseq := subseqA.filter (fun l => subseqB.contains l); String.mk (commonSubseq.foldl (fun best l => if best.length < l.length then l else best) [])) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro s1 s2 h
  unfold longestCommonSubsequence_postcond
  intro allSubseq subseqA subseqB commonSubseq
  have hnil : [] ∈ commonSubseq := List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨List.mem_map.mpr ⟨[], Refine.allsub_nil_mem s1.toList [[]] (by simp), rfl⟩, List.contains_iff_mem.mpr (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨[], Refine.allsub_nil_mem s2.toList [[]] (by simp), rfl⟩)⟩
  exact lcs_str_spec commonSubseq hnil
